notes: Samsung's spec table prints Folded/Unfolded as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH -- the second value is identical folded and unfolded (the hinge-axis dimension), so it is mapped to `height` and the first value to `width`. Folded thickness is published as a RANGE 15.7mm ~ 17.1mm and unfolded as 6.9mm ~ 7.6mm; the larger value of each range is recorded as depth. Samsung does NOT label which end of the range is the hinge side on this 2019 release (unlike Fold2-Fold4, which label '(Hinge)'), so depth_at_hinge is left null. Display refresh rate is not stated in the spec table (the Galaxy Fold predates Samsung's 120Hz foldables) -- left null rather than assumed. Panel labelled 'Dynamic AMOLED' / 'Super AMOLED' -> OLED. No frame/back/cover-glass material is given in this press release; the main screen is a polymer Infinity Flex Display, so materials left null. announced = the date line on the Samsung Newsroom press release itself. Refresh/free-stop/crease: no OEM statement -> null. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
